test-set.name: file-is-dir
test-set.description: Tests for the extension functions in the EXPath "file" package. The tests rely on being able to modify a “sandpit” folder. The sandpit element in the environment instructs the test driver to copy that folder to a “sandpit” directory in a temporary location and set the current working directory to that temporary location.

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-001
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on an existing file

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-002
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on an existing directory

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-003
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on a non-existing file

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-004
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on the current directory

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-005
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on the parent of the current directory

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-006
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on an empty sequence

test-case.name: EXPath-file-isDir-007
test-case.description: Use file:is-dir on an sequence of more than one entry
